guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, the flops u_prim_flop_ab_gamma_ss and u_prim_flop_ab_gamma10 asynchronously reset their outputs to 0.
When we_i[0] is asserted and rst_ni is high, on the rising edge of clk_i the flops capture their d_i inputs and update the corresponding outputs.

The aes_dom_dep_mul_gf2pn instance u_aes_dom_mul_gamma1_gamma0 continuously connects its ports as specified, so nets a_gamma1_gamma0, b_gamma1_gamma0, and b_gamma10_prd2 are driven by the submodule's internal logic.

assumptions.claim: The write enable we_i[0] must be glitch-free and asserted only when input shares (a_gamma_ss_d, b_gamma_ss_d, a_gamma1, a_gamma0, b_gamma1, b_gamma0) are stable and valid.
assumptions.cond: During any clock cycle where we_i[0] is used
assumptions.risk: A glitch on we_i[0] could cause the flops to capture intermediate or uncontrolled values, leading to correlated randomness output b_gamma10_prd2 and SCA leakage through downstream DOM multipliers.

assumptions.claim: The randomness input prd_2_i must be uniformly distributed and independent of all sensitive shares (a_gamma1/0, b_gamma1/0).
assumptions.risk: If prd_2_i is predictable or correlated, the output b_gamma10_prd2 may not be independent of the shares, breaking the DOM masking layer and enabling SCA attacks.

assumptions.claim: The instantiated submodule aes_dom_dep_mul_gf2pn correctly implements the DOM multiplication and ensures that its outputs a_q, b_q are proper masked multiplication shares and that prd_o is a blinded, uniformly distributed randomness independent of the input shares.
assumptions.cond: When we_i[0] is asserted and inputs are valid
assumptions.risk: A flawed submodule could directly expose secret shares or produce biased randomness, compromising the entire masking countermeasure and leading to secret leakage.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment states that interleaving b_gamma1/0_q and halves of b_gamma10_prd2 in other S-Box instances is essential to avoid SCA leakage from a glitch on the write-enable of downstream DOM-indep multipliers. It is unknown whether the downstream instances actually perform this interleaving.
uncertain_points.cond: Whenever b_gamma10_prd2 and b_gamma1/0_q are consumed in Stages 3/4 of another S-Box
uncertain_points.risk: If interleaving is missing, a glitch on we_i in those downstream instances could propagate unmasked or correlated values, exposing secret information via side channels.

uncertain_points.claim: The enable we_i[0] determines when the pipelined shares (a_gamma1_q, etc.) are updated. If we_i[0] is asserted before new shares are valid or after they have changed, the captured values may be stale or mismatched, potentially breaking the masking formula.
uncertain_points.cond: At the rising edge of clk_i when we_i[0] is asserted
uncertain_points.risk: Stale shares can produce incorrect masked outputs from the multiplier, leading to functional errors or correlated intermediate values that leak secret information.
